description: This file defines routing constants and a Router class for navigation in a Flutter application. It includes route name constants, a route factory method for generating routes with initial tab index, and internal route index mapping logic.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: Holds static route name constants used for navigation between app tabs.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Provides a static method to generate a route factory for navigation with tab index support.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Returns a RouteFactory that creates MaterialPageRoutes for navigation, passing the initial index based on route name.

methods.name: _indexForRoute
methods.description: Private method that maps route names to tab indices.
